messages:
Ana: Quick sync — we need a crosswalk table that maps old SDK fields -> new v4 fields for partners (marketplace, HW SIs). Who can take point?
Mike: I can draft the table. Do we have the final schema changes from eng?
Ravi: Pushed the change list to the repo yesterday: https://git.redwood.internal/partner-migrations. Highlights: auth header rename, batch payload shape, streaming protocol tweak.
Leah: HW partners need binary ABI compatibility note — obviate shim requirement for 3 months.
Sam: For marketplace, packaging needs a manifest v2, we can include a shim adapter for 60 days. I'll confirm with infra.
Jen: Communication plan: we want a staggered public deprec on June 1; partners get 90-day grace. Need partner-specific calendar.
Ana: Good. Can we table the migration steps into three tiers: critical (auth), recommended (batch), optional (envelope)?
Mike: Yup. I'll create a Google sheet and populate with rows: field, impacted SDKs, mitigation, sample code.
Mike: sample snippet for auth rename:
```http
POST /v1/requests
Headers:
  Authorization: Bearer <token>  ->  X-Redwood-Auth: <token>
```
Ravi: Also flag model routing fallback behavior — partners using dedicated might see variant routing differences.
Leah: Hardware SIs: propose a canary window where we run compatibility tests on their test fleet. 2 weeks.
Sam: Ops: can you expose a telemetry flag? we need telemetry for failed migration hits.
Jen: I'll draft the partner email template. Include: timeline, upgrade steps, rollback plan, contact + scheduled office hours link.
Ana: Action items:
- Mike: sheet + code snippets (due Thu noon)
- Ravi: upstream change summary + small migration lib (due Wed)
- Leah: SI canary schedule (due Wed)
- Sam: packaging/manifest plan + ops flag (due Thu)
- Jen: comms + office hours (due Fri)
Ana: Also decide whether we gate marketplace listings on SDK version; my vote: soft-gate with grace.
Mike: soft-gate + automatic compatibility badge would help partners.
Ravi: deploy-bot: will create feature-flag for telemetry.
deploy-bot: feature-flag create telemetry.partner_migration true
Leah: OK let's review the sheet in the tabletop on Thursday 10am PT. Invite sent.
Ana: Thanks everyone — uploading the draft to the partners repo after lunch. :thumbsup:
